_comment: Copy to agent.config.json and edit. Path: C:\Serenade\agent.config.json.
_isolation_comment: R3: self-report the isolation primitive. Orchestrator refuses high-risk jobs to 'none' unless SERENADE_WINDOWS_WORKER_ALLOW_UNSAFE_ISOLATION=1. One of: hyperv-snapshot | firecracker | bare-metal | none.
_signing_key_comment: R3: shared HMAC key (>=16 chars) used to verify 'assembly' jobs. MUST match SERENADE_WINDOWS_WORKER_SIGNING_KEY on the orchestrator. Without this set, assembly jobs are rejected.
